content: .{@-राज्@} king of birds, eagle; अथ तार्क्ष्यसुतो ज्ञात्वा विराट्प्रभुचिकीर्षितम् <ls>Bhāg. 8. 21. 26</ls>.

विराज् .²1 <ls>U. 1</ls> To shine, glitter; शाखिनोऽन्ये विराजन्ते खण्ड्यन्ते चन्दनद्रुमाः <ls>Bv. 1. 88</ls>. .²2 To appear or look like; तदन्तरे सा विरराज धेनुः <ls>R. 2. 20</ls>. .²3 To be eminent or illustrious. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} To brighten, illuminate, irradiate.

विराज् {%a.%} .²1 Splendid, excellent; मृत्युर्भोजपतेर्विराडविदुषां तत्त्वं परं योगिनाम् <ls>Bhāg. 10. 43. 17</ls>. .²2 A ruler, chief. --{%m.%} .²1 Beauty, splendour. .²2 A man of the Kṣatriya or warrior tribe; विराडायुषोऽर्धमथात्यगात् <ls>Bhāg. 4. 27. 6</ls>. .²3 The first progeny of Brahman; <ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Ms. 1. 32</ls>; तस्मात् विराडजायत <ls>Rv. 10. 90. 5</ls> (where विराज् is represented as born from {%Puruṣa%}). .²4 The body. .²5 (In Vedānta <ab>phil.</ab>) <ab>N.</ab> of ‘intellect’ considered as ruling over the aggregate of bodies. .²6 The universe (ब्रह्माण्ड); नानावीर्याः पृथग्भूता विराजं जनयन्ति हि <ls>Bhāg. 10. 3. 15</ls>. --{%f.%} .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of a Vedic metre. .²2 Excellence, dignity.
